$comment: Design tokens for fazaieli.ir. Source of truth — tokens.css is generated from this. Colours were sampled from photographs of the institute and the logo (HSV clustering), then contrast-checked against WCAG 2.1. See docs/04-information-architecture.md.

meta.method: k-means over HSV on institute and logo photography, then WCAG 2.1 contrast verification

ground.note: cool white, from the corridors — never #FFF, never warm ivory

lapis.role: brand blue, the one saturated field

gold.rule: decoration only — never behind a glyph on light ground

sand.note: also the primary-button foreground (ink bg / sand text) — 11:1 on ink, safe

mist.role: cool placeholder fill for imagery blocks before real photography

linen.role: warm panel fill — payment/receipt surfaces, distinct from ground and sand

firouzehText.role: firouzeh when it carries words on light ground

goldText.role: gold when it carries words on light ground

hairline.note: the gold rule — separation without shadows

space.$comment: Section rhythm matters more than micro-spacing here. 96px is the minimum gap between sections on desktop.

radius.$comment: Two values only. Nothing in between, so the two never read as a mistake.

fa.$comment: Estedad or Morabba may replace display later. All faces self-hosted from /public/fonts — never fetched at runtime.

type.$comment: px at desktop; scale down one step below 768px.

motion.rule: fades and 8–16px rises only. No parallax, no bounce, no autoplay. Honour prefers-reduced-motion.

rooms.$comment: Each space carries one accent; ink is the constant.
